name: Intents Checkout – Crypto Payments for WooCommerce
author: Intents

sections.description:
Accept crypto in your WooCommerce store. Customers pay with any token on any chain; you receive one asset, on one chain, in your own wallet.

Intents Checkout adds a “Pay with crypto” option to WooCommerce. Your prices stay in US dollars. Customers pay with whatever they hold: USDT on Tron, native Bitcoin, SOL, ETH on any major network, and 3,000+ other assets on 18 chains. You choose the one asset you want to receive, for example USDC on Base or USDT on Tron, and every payment arrives as exactly that.

Intents never holds your money. Each payment goes straight to the wallet address you set. There are no balances to withdraw and no payouts to wait for.

How it works

  1. Install the plugin and press Connect intents.fi. No keys to copy.
  2. Choose your settlement asset and wallet in the Intents dashboard.
  3. At checkout, the customer picks Pay with crypto and is sent to a secure payment page.
  4. They pay from their wallet or an exchange, with the cheapest option they hold already selected.
  5. Your settlement asset arrives in your wallet, a signed webhook reaches your store, and the order moves to Processing.

What your customers see

  • The price first. The order total is the first thing on the payment page, then the way to pay.
  • Plain language. One all-in amount to send, the network to send it on, and a clear warning not to use any other.
  • Two ways to pay. Connect a wallet (MetaMask, Phantom, TronLink and other browser wallets), or send from an exchange such as Binance or OKX with a QR code and the exact amount.
  • A safety net. Customers give a refund address before sending from an exchange, so a payment that can’t be completed goes back to them automatically.

Why merchants choose Intents Checkout

  • Non-custodial. Funds go from the customer straight to your wallet. Intents never takes custody.
  • One settlement asset. Whatever the customer pays with, you receive the stablecoin you chose, on the network you chose.
  • Best available rate, with failover. Every payment is routed across several independent liquidity networks. If one is slow or down, checkout keeps working.
  • The exact amount. A $49.00 order delivers $49.00 of your settlement asset, less the 0.4% fee.
  • No chargebacks. Crypto payments can’t be reversed by the payer. Refunds are your decision.
  • Your brand. Set your logo, colours, fonts and corners for the payment page in the dashboard.

Features

  • Customers pay with 3,000+ assets on 18 chains, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Tron, Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, OP Mainnet, Polygon and Avalanche
  • You settle in USDC or USDT on a supported network
  • Connect your store in a few clicks: keys and payment notifications are set up for you, with Go live and Disconnect on the same screen. Manual key entry also works
  • Orders are marked paid only by a signed confirmation, and only once your funds have been delivered
  • Underpayments handled: the customer is shown the exact remaining amount and can top up to the same address
  • Late payments (after the payment window closed) are put On hold with a note, so you decide whether to fulfil
  • Works with the WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks and the classic checkout
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Test mode, so you can place orders without moving real funds
  • Email notifications for payments received and anything that needs your attention
  • A merchant dashboard at dashboard.intents.fi with every payment, its status and its transactions

Who it’s for

Stores that sell to crypto holders anywhere in the world: digital goods, software and SaaS, hosting, games, travel, and physical products shipped internationally. Merchants are responsible for checking that accepting crypto payments is allowed where they operate.

Pricing

0.4% per completed payment, charged by the Intents Checkout service. No setup fee, no monthly fee, no fixed fee per payment, so a $5 payment costs 2 cents. Test mode is free. The plugin is free.

Requirements

  • An Intents account, free to create at https://intents.fi/signup
  • WooCommerce 8.9 or later, WordPress 6.5 or later, PHP 8.0 or later
  • Store currency set to US dollars (USD)
  • HTTPS on your store, so payment notifications can reach it

External services

This plugin is a connector to Intents Checkout, a third-party payment service operated by Intents (intents.fi). It cannot take payments without it, and it needs an Intents account and API key.

It connects to three intents.fi hosts:

  • api.intents.fi — the Intents API. Called from your server:
    • When an order is placed with this payment method: the plugin sends the order total and currency, a reference made from the order ID and a short code for your store (order_<id>-<code>), a short description (“Order 1042 at “), the order-received and order-pay URLs to return the customer to, the customer’s billing email address (if they gave one, for their receipt), and the order ID, number and order key, your site URL and the plugin version (so a payment can be matched back to its order).
    • When a customer returns to pay an order that already has a payment: the plugin asks the API for that payment’s status, so it never creates a second one for a paid order.
    • When an order’s total changes before it is paid: the plugin closes the earlier payment through the API.
    • When you press “Test connection” in the settings: the plugin asks the API which merchant account your key belongs to.
    • When you come back from Connect intents.fi: the plugin sends the one-time code it was given, a secret it made when you pressed Connect, and your site URL, and receives your keys. It then registers your store’s webhook URL with the new key.
    • When you press “Disconnect”: the plugin asks the API to revoke the keys Connect made.
    • Every other request is authenticated with your Intents secret API key.
  • dashboard.intents.fi — the Intents dashboard. When you press Connect intents.fi or Go live, your browser is sent there with your site URL, the address to return to, the mode (test or live) and two random values the plugin made for this request. You sign in and approve there; nothing is sent from your server.
  • pay.intents.fi — the hosted payment page. The customer’s browser is sent there to pay, and the page talks to Intents directly. Wallet and refund addresses the customer enters or connects there are used only to complete or refund the payment.

Intents sends payment status updates (webhooks) back to your store’s REST endpoint, /wp-json/intentsfi/v1/webhook, signed with your webhook secret. The plugin rejects any it cannot verify.

To fill a payment, the Intents Checkout service passes the payment details it needs (amounts, assets, destination and refund addresses) to the independent liquidity network that fills it. These providers are described in the Intents privacy policy.

Intents terms of service: https://intents.fi/terms
Intents privacy policy: https://intents.fi/privacy

Source code

The block checkout script ships compiled in build/. Its human-readable source is included in this plugin, in src/index.js, with the build configuration (package.json, webpack.config.js). To rebuild it, from the plugin folder run npm install and then npm run build (Node.js 20 or later). This uses @wordpress/scripts and @woocommerce/dependency-extraction-webpack-plugin. All PHP ships uncompiled.

Documentation and support

  • Setup guide: https://intents.fi/docs/checkout/woocommerce
  • WooCommerce integration: https://intents.fi/integrations/woocommerce
  • Support, by email: support@intents.fi
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin, search for Intents Checkout, then install and activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Intents Checkout and press Connect intents.fi.
  3. Sign in to (or sign up for) the Intents dashboard and approve the connection. You come back to WordPress connected in test mode, with your keys and payment notifications set up. Nothing to copy.
  4. Tick Enable Intents Checkout, save, and place a test order. The order moves to Processing when the test payment completes.
  5. When your Intents account is ready for live payments, press Go live. The store switches to live mode only when that round trip finishes.

Prefer to paste keys? Under Enter keys manually, paste your ik_test_… key from the dashboard, add the Webhook URL shown there on the dashboard’s Webhooks page, paste the whsec_… secret it shows, and press Test connection.

Your store currency must be US dollars (USD): the payment method stays hidden at checkout otherwise.
sections.faq:
How do I accept crypto payments in WooCommerce?

Install Intents Checkout, press Connect intents.fi, choose the wallet you want to be paid in, and enable the payment method. Customers then see Pay with crypto at checkout. Setup takes a few minutes and starts in test mode.

Can I accept USDT and USDC in WooCommerce?

Yes. Customers can pay with USDT on Tron, Ethereum and other networks, USDC on Base, Solana and others, and thousands of other tokens. You receive USDC or USDT on the network you chose, whatever the customer paid with.

Do you hold my funds?

No. Payments are delivered straight to the wallet address you set in the dashboard. Intents never has custody of your money.

Which coins can my customers pay with?

3,000+ assets on 18 chains, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Tron, Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, OP Mainnet, Polygon and Avalanche. The payment page only shows options that can be filled for the order amount at that moment.

What do I receive?

One asset that you choose: USDC or USDT on a supported network. Every payment arrives in that asset, whatever the customer paid with.

What does it cost?

0.4% of each completed payment, with no setup, monthly or fixed per-payment fee. The fee is shown on every payment in your dashboard. Test mode is free.

When is an order marked paid?

Only when Intents confirms that your settlement asset has been delivered to your wallet. A payment that has been sent but not yet delivered adds an order note and leaves the order unpaid.

What happens if a customer sends the wrong amount?

If they send too little, the payment page shows the exact remaining amount to send to the same address. If a payment can’t be completed, it is returned to the customer’s refund address. If they send too much, the order is marked paid and the extra is flagged in your dashboard.

What if a customer pays after the payment window has closed?

The money still reaches your wallet. The order is put On hold with a note and a notice in WordPress admin, because it may already have been cancelled and its stock released. You decide whether to fulfil it.

How do refunds work?

Payments are non-custodial, so a refund is sent from your own wallet. Refunding an order in WooCommerce records it there but does not move any funds. A payment that can’t be completed is returned to the customer automatically, without you doing anything.

Can customers pay from an exchange like Binance or OKX?

Yes. They choose to pay from an exchange or other wallet, then send the exact amount on the network shown. They are asked for a refund address on that network first.

Are there chargebacks?

No. Crypto payments can’t be reversed by the payer.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes. It supports both the Cart and Checkout blocks and the classic shortcode checkout.

Can I test before going live?

Yes. Connect starts in test mode. Test payments run end to end and never move real funds. Switch with Go live when your account is ready.

Do I need to verify my business?

Yes, lightly: your legal name, website, country and a contact.

Where do I get help?

Email support@intents.fi. Support is by email.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • Translations: admin screens, checkout and order notes now available in French, Indonesian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Italian, Turkish, Vietnamese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese. WordPress.org language packs take priority once approved.

0.1.0

  • First release: crypto payments for WooCommerce with block and classic checkout support, test mode, HPOS compatibility and signed webhook confirmations.
  • Connect intents.fi: connect your store in a few clicks, with no keys to copy. Keys and payment notifications are set up for you; Go live and Disconnect from the same screen. Manual key entry still works.
  • Late payments are put on hold for the merchant to decide, never completed automatically.
  • A customer returning to an order whose payment has already gone through is never asked to pay again.
  • Payments are matched to your store and order, so two stores on one Intents account never share a payment.
